reviews.title: ما يوصلني إشعار إلا أدخل ع التطبيق
Missed isnad hadith
reviews.text: The only thing is that the Hadiths compiled so far that I've come across are from Bihar Al-Anwar, which is considered a Shia book and has no isnad (chain of narration). Shia or Sunni, hadiths should be sound and authentic, and the chain of narration establishes that. I am not trying to be a contrarian or bash the developer, for their intention may be pure. All I am saying is that if you are more learned and can suss out what's what, then this should be fine. But, for a beginner or someone new to Islam, this may cause a person to not follow the proper teachings of the Prophet (SAW). And Allah knows best.

reviews.title: Misleading Title and Conten
reviews.text: This app although has benefits but masks the contents that it releases daily. First to begin with this app is a Shia content based and most of the hadiths are not authentic. Daily it releases saying and narrations which are partially unknown. So I would not recommend if you are Sunni Muslim to not download this app. As for a Shia identifying person please confirm the authenticity of the hadiths and narrations with your scholars before reading, learning and sharing these. As for the owners and developers of this app please be conscious of Allah and do not spread misinformation, and weak hadiths or narrations of Sahaba or The followers of Sahaba. Any fabricated Hadith or a narration from a scholar is a big sin, and fabricating in this deen of Allah and his messenger has severe consequences in this world and the hereafter. May Allah forgive us all and unite/guide us in the straight path that the messengers and the righteous followed. Glory be to Allah.
